verdict.rationale: Cognee's multi-user permissions system explicitly provides dataset-scoped isolation so multiple users/organizations can share one instance while keeping their data separate, which supports the 'private stays private' half of the story. However, the docs describe isolation/access control at a high level without concrete detail on how to explicitly share or grant access to specific datasets to a team or group of agents (e.g., role assignment, invite flows), so the 'shared team memory' half is only implied, not demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit sharing/grant mechanics for team or group datasets, multi-agent shared-memory examples, and any independent confirmation of this permission model in practice.
